properties.entry:
A ScrollbarBehavior from ui-components gives a scrolling component scroll bars that look the same in every browser: the native ones are hidden and slim bars in the colors of the theme are drawn over the edges of the component. It keeps scrolling natively with the wheel, the keys and touch; the thumb can be dragged and a click on the track pages towards the click.

The first box keeps the browser's own scroll bar, to compare. The behavior draws the bars in the directions the CSS of the component lets it scroll, or in those given to it: the third box asks for the horizontal one only. The bars follow changes of the content: The + button re-renders the last box via Ajax, its bar picks up the new size and the behavior scrolls the box to the first of the lines added; the other buttons scroll it to its top, its bottom, a position and a line. Change the theme in the top bar and the bars follow it.
Line {0}: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, again and again and again.
